description.en: A small macOS menu bar app that keeps your files in sync with Google Drive.
description.zh: 轻巧的 macOS 菜单栏工具，把文件和文件夹同步到 Google Drive。

source.description: macOS menu bar utility that syncs files and folders to Google Drive via rsync

subject.en: Original grey faceted shrike with a dark eye mask
subject.zh: 保留原图的灰色碎片化伯劳与深色眼罩

description.en: The original head, hooked beak, eye mask, shoulders, and canvas are preserved exactly. The existing compact silhouette stays the source of every foreground size.
description.zh: 头部、钩状鸟喙、眼罩、肩羽和画布全部原样保留，现有紧凑轮廓是所有透明尺寸的唯一来源。

description.en: The silver crown, charcoal eye band, blue-grey beak, and warm shoulder facets are untouched. No new ornament or image-generation call is needed for this retained identity.
description.zh: 银灰头顶、炭黑眼带、蓝灰鸟喙与暖色肩羽均未修改。这次沿用既有形象，不增加装饰或调用生图。

description.en: Oversized angular pleats enter a slate field from opposite corners. Narrow edge highlights and a low shadow give the grey bird separation without adding a scene.
description.zh: 大幅折翼纹从对角进入石板色底面，细边高光和轻浅阴影让灰色主体清晰浮现，保持图标简洁。

sizeNote.en: The beak and dark eye band carry the mark at small sizes. Menu bar template icons keep their existing monochrome silhouette; app, toolbar, and browser derivatives retain their distinct roles.
sizeNote.zh: 小尺寸由鸟喙与深色眼带承担识别。菜单栏模板图保留现有单色轮廓；应用、工具栏与浏览器图标分别按各自用途处理。

goal.en: Back up selected files and development configurations on a Mac to Google Drive's local directory, with sync triggered from the app or a local HTTP request.
goal.zh: 在 Mac 上将选定文件和开发配置备份到 Google Drive 的本地目录，通过应用或本机 HTTP 请求触发同步。

description.en: Broad angular pleats and short inset seams echo folded wings at opposite corners of the canvas.
description.zh: 宽阔折面与内收短缝在画面对角相互呼应，像伯劳安静收拢的双翼。

alt.en: Original grey faceted shrike with a dark eye mask on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 保留原图的灰色碎片化伯劳与深色眼罩，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Grey faceted shrike with a dark eye mask.
description.zh: 灰色碎片化伯劳与深色眼罩。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥74px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 74px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
